entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Cui Bi was a high-ranking official in the Jin dynasty of Northern China, serving as the Inspector of the North from 581 to 589 CE.

As Inspector, Cui Bi played a crucial role in the unification of Northern China under the Jin dynasty, which eventually led to the reunification of the Two Chinasthat had been fragmented since the Northern and Southern Dynasties period.

Cui Bi's leadership and military prowess were instrumental in the Jin dynasty's conquest of the Northern Zhou and its subsequent rise to power, marking the beginning of a new era in Chinese history.

The Jin dynasty's legacy, including its administrative reforms and cultural achievements, continued to shape Chinese society for centuries to come.

The famous quote 'A single grain of rice can cause a ripple that becomes a wave' comes from Cui Bi's own words, encapsulating the profound impact he had on the course of Chinese history.
